abstract: Twenty cases of ovarian or testicular teratomas were studied with a sensitive peroxidase-antiperoxidase (PAP) method utilizing an antibody to glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP). Positive staining was restricted to the perikaryon, to extensively distributed neuroglial fibrils, or to ependymal lining cells in 13 of 20 teratomas studied. Positively stained cells were also occasionally observed in the choroid plexus, thus indicating the possibility that such cells also retain the capability of producing GFAP. GFAP-positive material was also found in the tumour cells of an undifferentiated ovarian teratocarcinoma; this tumour was believed to represent an ovarian glioma. It is concluded that the PAP method represents a sensitive and valuable histochemical tool which should be further explored to characterize a functional basis of normal and neoplastic cells. Findings are of particular interest in the "germ cell tumours" in which multiple differentiation patterns may be expressed.
abstract_ja: 卵巣または精巣奇形腫20例を、グリア線維性酸性タンパク質（GFAP）に対する抗体を用いた感度の高いペルオキシダーゼ・抗ペルオキシダーゼ（PAP）法で検討した。20例中13例の奇形腫では、陽性染色は核周囲細胞質、広く分布する神経膠線維、または上衣細胞に限られた。脈絡叢の細胞にも陽性細胞が時折認められ、これらの細胞もGFAP産生能を保持している可能性が示された。未分化な卵巣奇形癌の腫瘍細胞にもGFAP陽性物質が認められ、この腫瘍は卵巣の神経膠腫であると考えられた。PAP法は、正常細胞および腫瘍性細胞の機能的基盤を特徴づけるための、感度が高く有用な組織化学的ツールであり、さらに検討されるべきである。特に、多様な分化パターンを発現しうる胚細胞腫瘍において関心が持たれる所見である。
